comment: Batch 2026-11-11-aqueous-solvents, W3b step 2: water as a compound of the cubic in main data (properties/cubic_water.json, icheme:cubic_water), the Water of the test pilot (no main package names it until W3b step 3). Same values as the W2b pilot record (selection-aqueous-pilot.json). No compound and no pair library.

cubic_water.freezing_note: Water melts at 273.1525 K at 1 atm, 0.0075 K below its triple point: normal_melting_kelvin holds the triple point, as the anchor does.
cubic_water.source: Water as a compound of the PR78 cubic (batch 2026-11-11-aqueous-solvents, plan M2): IAPWS-95 critical point (Tc 647.096 K, Pc 22.064 MPa), acentric factor 0.3443, normal boiling point 373.124 K, standard liquid density 999.0 kg/m3 at 60 F (IAPWS-95, rounded); Mathias-Copeman alpha c1 0.91976, c2 -0.33844, c3 0.33431 matched to the Wagner-Pruss saturation line from 0 to 370 C (tools/aqueous-solvents/cubic-water.mjs).

modified-unifac-dortmund.source: Water is the one subgroup H2O (subgroup 16, main group 7) of modified UNIFAC (Dortmund).

eppr78-2022.source: Water is the one group H2O (G16) of E-PPR78 (Jaubert et al. 2022).
